description:
Remove one of your webhook endpoints. No more events go to it, and its signing secret is gone: an endpoint created again gets a new secret.
Use for: stopping events to a URL, making room for another endpoint, or restarting one that was switched off after failures.
Not for: seeing your endpoints and their ids (list_webhook_endpoints).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: delete_webhook_endpoint({"endpointId":"Wk3pQ8vN1sXr6TzL0aBc"})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: delete_webhook_endpoint
title: Delete a webhook endpoint
